text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I've grasped the general structure. 
I believe I can repair it.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association President
text_block_list.text:
Really? What a relief, it'll make it in 
time for the festival! Thank you for 
working so hard too, Biko-chan.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Guhhh, I'm sorry! I looked things up and 
tried everything I could, but it was total 
gibberish to me...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Believe-senpai, is there anything I can do 
to help? I'll do whatever it takes!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing in particular at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Alright! In that case, I'll go 
patrol the town!

text_block_list.name: Wagashi Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Man, that really helps. If my back wasn't 
thrown out, it'd be a piece of cake. 
Alright, go ahead and load the sugar bags 
onto that cart over there—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It'll be way faster if I carry them all at 
once! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hrk!? Nnnnnnrgh! I-It's so heavyyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Wagashi Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't push yourself too hard!? I'll 
bring the cart right over!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to serve this! Carefully, 
one by one this time... Nice and steady, 
nice and slow...

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me~, I asked for extra-firm 
noodles, so I was kind of hoping to eat 
them while they're fresh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What kind of hero causes trouble 
everywhere they go?! Ugh, maybe I should 
just call it a day and head home...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...What should I do here?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ! A troubled face spotted! Hero, move out—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No, wait... But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Ngggh!! No way, absolutely not!! Am I 
seriously going to look the other way just 
because I'm having an off day?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I am everyone's hero! Justice Biko, 
arriving on the sceeeene!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—So you want it to support a wider range 
of movements so it doesn't break again?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Figuring out how to execute those 
movements is the challenge. I am no street 
performer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! In that case, I might actually be 
able to help with that!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hup, hop, hup!! How's something like 
this?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...! ...Can it handle intense movements 
like that as well?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Leave it to me! I'm totally 
used to this from hero shows!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...It is finished. With this, the repairs 
on the shishimai lion mask are complete.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank goodness...! You really are 
amazing, Believe-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No... The credit goes to you, Biko-san. 
For staying this late to help verify the 
movements.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It was nothing! When it comes to helping 
people, give it your all! That's what a 
hero does!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...A job well done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One rainy day, while walking along the 
riverbank on an errand—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't go that way, kitty! That's the 
river!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHHH!!
choice_data_list: Whoa, that was in the nick of time...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was completely captivated watching Biko 
Pegasus rescue the cat without a second 
thought about getting soaked!
